out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Vision split: one POV from his eyes and another from ~30–40 feet up, 'as if I was in the sky above the house' with the roof not there; could see every room and everybody in the house.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Time slowed down to extremes; dual simultaneous viewpoints during the fall and impact.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Initially fell rapidly through a vast void; passed through multiple thin 'walls' of white light; then through clouds and into an enormous tunnel where he stopped falling and floated.

arrival.other_being_detail: Described many 'larger soul' guides in the tunnel; two 'larger guide souls' approached and pushed him into a nearby 'ball of fire' realm.

environment.environment_other_detail: Vast void of nothing; repeated thin 'walls' of pure white light with loud electrical hum; clouds/fog; enormous tunnel with cloud-like walls; 'balls of electric fire' in vivid colors; end of tunnel opened to a transparent golden-brick wall with tall doors and stairs; inside was 'light blue fog'.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Instantly and forcibly 'slammed back into my body' (also described as 'forcibly slammed back' and later waking to doctors/nurses).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell off bed and head/forehead crushed through a glass and hit a wooden end table; heavy bleeding; later at doctors/hospital.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Stated: had never been to church, didn't know what a Bible was or God; believed death meant nonexistence because mother told him.
person_demographics.occupation: Research and Development Lab Technician (also ex-Navy; advanced electronics/computers/radar training).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Multiple 'walls' of white light; many 'souls' and 'guide souls'; brief rapid 'image flashing' sequence resembling a life review/preview; forced return with medical scene.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE during fall/house view → void/falling → repeated walls of white light → clouds → tunnel with golden light and many 'balls of fire'/souls and guides → view of golden wall/doors/stairs (boundary) → pushed into a 'ball of fire' with rapid flashing images → forced return to body/medical scene.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated passage through multiple thin 'walls of white light' (about eight).
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Simultaneous dual perspective (from his eyes and from above) during the fall/impact and immediate aftermath.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated 'walls' of white light with loud electrical hum; tunnel populated by countless 'balls of electric fire' connected by strings that were actually moving rows of people; strong affect gradient (fear near tunnel walls, love/comfort at center); guides pushing him into a specific 'ball of fire' realm; rapid flashing still images including a future-like scene of a young woman holding his newborn baby and a dull golden castle floating in darkness.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My vision then split, as I was now able to see from two different points of view.” / “it was simply an enormously large and vast void of nothing.” / “my body was made up of a bluish green colored aura of light” / “I fell through about eight of them.” / “The best part... was when I retracted back towards the center of the tunnel; it felt so good, so peaceful, and so secure.” / “Then everything began to swirl... as I was instantly and forcibly slammed back into my body.”
